scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.railway:build: BASE_PATH=/ PORT=3000 pnpm --filter @workspace/bioconstruccion run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.railway:start: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push-force && NODE_ENV=production SERVE_STATIC_DIR=artifacts/bioconstruccion/dist/public pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
